name: Engram fresh-data test on LongMemEval, rule fixed on 6 November 2026 before any answer from this data was seen
data: xiaowu0162/longmemeval-cleaned, longmemeval_s_cleaned.json (MIT licence), each question with its own chat history
design: exactly frozen_design.json: same search, same token limits, same answer prompt and model; nothing tuned on this data
training: networks train on LoCoMo conversations 0 to 4 only, never on LongMemEval
adapter: needed because this data differs: messages split into sentences (no words changed; longest piece 600 characters); dates written in the form Engram reads; today's date added to the question for the model, not for the search; a fact prompt over 3,000 tokens keeps user lines first, then assistant lines
development: the 30 questions with the lowest hash of their question id, for speed and adapter checks only; never counted in the result
test_questions: all other questions, including the not-answerable ones
ways: current Engram and networks without facts on every test question; facts are not tested in this run
facts_questions_rule: changed from 75 to 0 on 6 November 2026, before any test answers existed, at Manj's request to shorten the run from about 10 hours to about 3; the facts part would in any case have been too small to show a small gain
score: blind labels, using LongMemEval's published per-type judging rules in kit_tools/lme_rules.md, applied by Claude agents; these are not the official GPT-4o judge, so the numbers must not be compared with published ones
primary_measure: networks without facts against current Engram, same questions; 95% interval by paired bootstrap; success only if the interval stays above zero
secondary: by question type; not-answerable questions; answer sessions and turns reached; answers of not mentioned
allowed_to_fail: the result is reported whichever way it goes; a failure here is not followed by tuning and retesting on these questions
